in_marathi.name: Charumati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Chariot of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charumati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charumati is a Sanskrit name that means the 'chariot of love'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that this name signifies the divine presence of love and compassion. Charumati is a name of Goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. The name is derived from the words 'Charu' meaning 'chariot' and 'Mati' meaning 'mind' or 'thought'. Thus, Charumati represents the divine chariot that carries our thoughts and emotions towards love and spiritual growth.
